push.description: The push chain alone, before the two provider chains were combined.

link.description: The link chain alone, before the combination. Pre-idempotency: bare CREATE TYPE.

provider.description: Both provider migrations, at the 0044/0045 numbering they carried before the CMS chain took precedence. Same statements, same `when`, different file names — so the content is read from the combined tree rather than duplicated.

cms.description: A database that ran the CMS Place Editor chain (#432/#434) and not this one — the order of record. Those migrations are on develop, so the state reads them from the combined tree rather than duplicating an epic this branch does not own.
